name: Tasets
shortDescription: A black, red, and gold set of leather tassets combining two Prince Armory pattern variants into one design.
description: This tasset set is based on patterns owned by Prince Armory. There are two versions of the original tasset design, and I combined elements from both versions to make a single set.
The finished color scheme uses black as the base, red around the edging, and gold for the accent work.
